original_description:
Falcon Herbs Whole Long Pepper (Pippali) is a premium, sun-dried, hand-selected spice rooted in ancient Ayurvedic tradition. Sourced from ethically cultivated farms, this whole long pepper retains its natural pungency, aromatic depth, and warm energy — cherished for centuries in culinary and herbal practices across South Asia.

Known for its bold, spicy flavor and distinctive elongated spikes, Long Pepper is a staple in traditional kitchens — enhancing the richness of biryanis, curries, kebabs, and spice blends. Its unique profile makes it a favored choice in Malaysian, Indonesian, and Indian culinary heritage, where it adds both warmth and complexity to savory dishes.

Why Choose Falcon Herbs Long Pepper?

  • 100% Pure, Whole Long Pepper — no grinding, no additives, no chemicals
  • Naturally sun-dried and hand-sorted for peak aroma and potency
  • Free from pesticides, preservatives, and artificial processing
  • Ideal for traditional spice blends, herbal infusions, and Ayurvedic preparations
  • Packaged in a resealable, eco-friendly pouch to preserve freshness
  • Warm in nature — traditionally valued for its balancing qualities in daily rituals

Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Use as a whole spice in cooking, or grind fresh to unlock its full essence. A timeless ingredient for those who honor the wisdom of tradition in every meal.

Origin: Sourced from sustainable farms in India — where Ayurveda and agriculture have walked hand in hand for millennia.

---
